display.purpose: One lapidary uppercase statement per page; enters via per-character carve.

body.purpose: EB Garamond reading text; italics for quotes and French flourishes.

label.purpose: Marcellus tracked caps for kickers, nav, buttons, marquee.

motion.name: ease-carve
motion.purpose: House ease (expo-out) for every entrance, curtain, and reveal.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Entrances: chars 0.65s, clip unveilings 1.2s, curtain lift 1.05s.

motion.name: lenis
motion.purpose: Inertial page scroll; off under reduced motion.

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: Nocturne primary CTA — gold leaf on night umber.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { background: hsl(38 52% 63%); color: hsl(26 20% 7%); padding: 16px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: Marcellus, Georgia, serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: hsl(38 52% 70%); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(38 52% 63%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button (Nocturne)
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: hsl(40 25% 90%); padding: 16px 32px; border: 1px solid hsla(40,25%,85%,0.35); border-radius: 0; font-family: Marcellus, Georgia, serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: hsla(40,25%,90%,0.1); }

components.name: Bronze Button (Daylight)
components.description: Daylight primary CTA — bronze on limestone.
components.css: .ds-btn-bronze { background: hsl(35 45% 37%); color: hsl(40 30% 97%); padding: 14px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: Marcellus, Georgia, serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-bronze:hover { background: hsl(35 45% 33%); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header link — tracked Marcellus caps with gold underline draw.
components.css: .ds-nav { position: relative; font-family: Marcellus, Georgia, serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: hsl(36 14% 68%); text-decoration: none; padding: 8px 0; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-nav::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; height: 1px; width: 0; background: hsl(38 52% 63%); transition: width 0.3s ease-out; } .ds-nav:hover { color: hsl(40 30% 91%); } .ds-nav:hover::after { width: 100%; }

components.name: Kicker Label
components.css: .ds-kicker { font-family: Marcellus, Georgia, serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.42em; text-transform: uppercase; color: hsl(38 52% 63%); }

components.name: Ruled Row
components.description: The house list pattern — hairline-ruled row, Marcellus lead, Garamond note.
components.html:
Europa Nostra

MEMBER SINCE 1963

Lebanon is the federation's only non-European member.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 2fr; gap: 24px; align-items: baseline; border-top: 1px solid #DFDAD4; padding: 28px 0; } .ds-row h3 { font-family: Marcellus, Georgia, serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0; } .ds-row span { font-family: Marcellus, Georgia, serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.25em; color: hsl(35 45% 37%); } .ds-row p { font-family: 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 17px; color: hsl(25 9% 35%); margin: 0; } .ds-row:hover h3 { color: hsl(35 45% 37%); transition: color 0.3s; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Contact form field — hairline stroke, square, bronze focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: hsl(40 12% 97%); border: 1px solid hsl(35 12% 80%); border-radius: 0; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font-family: 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 17px; color: hsl(24 12% 11%); } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid hsl(35 45% 37%); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: hsl(35 45% 37%); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(25 9% 35%); }

narrative.northStar: The Sursock Salon, by Candlelight and by Day
narrative.overview: A chiaroscuro world built around APSAD's real address on Sursock Street. Home and gallery are the nocturne: photography glowing out of near-black umber, gold leaf carrying the type. About and Get Involved are the daylight: limestone reading rooms with umber ink. Fully serif — Marcellus inscriptions over EB Garamond manuscript — with choreographed motion: an opening curtain, inertial scroll, characters carving in, and a scroll-driven horizontal timeline with a live year ticker.
keyCharacteristics: Chiaroscuro pacing: night-umber drench alternating with limestone daylight
Fully serif: Marcellus caps + EB Garamond text, no sans anywhere
Gold by night, bronze by day — the primary inverts with the ground
Square corners; depth from tonal inversion, never shadows
Film grain at 2.8%; 1px hairlines as the only ornament
Signature motion: preloader curtain, Lenis scroll, char-carve, pointer-parallax hero, clip-path unveilings, labeled cursor

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: Section contrast comes from full tonal inversion (nocturne ↔ limestone), never pastel tints.

rules.name: The Gold-Is-Light Rule
rules.body: Gold behaves like light, not paint: type, hairlines, nodes, small fills. Never large gold surfaces.

rules.name: The Carve Rule
rules.body: Display type enters like an inscription: per-character rise from blur, 26–34ms stagger, expo ease.

rules.name: The Stone-Doesn't-Float Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows on cards, buttons, or sections — invert or rule off instead.

dos: Do keep every corner square; --radius stays 0rem.
Do guard every animation with prefers-reduced-motion.
Do write scrim alphas as hsla(h,s%,l%,a) arbitrary values — Tailwind slash opacity silently fails on arbitrary hsl here.
Do pace long pages by inversion: nocturne → limestone → nocturne.
Do address the reader as a patron, never with donation-urgency mechanics.
Do use real content from the apsad.net record.
donts: Don't build the generic charity template (progress bars, crisis photography, donate ribbons).
Don't ship the dusty museum archive.
Don't import startup/SaaS modernism (gradients, rounded cards, glassmorphism).
Don't apply font-bold to Marcellus — single weight, synthesis disabled.
Don't add a second scroll-hijacked section — The Record is the only one.
